allow: PowerShell($conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if \($conn\) { Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$\($conn.OwningProcess\)" | Select-Object ProcessId, CommandLine | Format-List })
